findings.classification: New source-derived conditional runtime-budget question; central controls cross-lens alias/count, actual export and resolution policy.
findings.claim: When a spaulder includes a besagew with RadialFluting::default(), its count24 maps to 288 columns (12 samples per spoke, with minimum96). The creator source offers enabling that default after adding the optional plate; default SpaulderDesign and BesagewDesign leave these options absent until selected. The disc uses 24 rows and CyclicApex, with no PlateFluting in its grid columns. Chart source lays out 23 cyclic strips of two triangles per column plus an apex fan: 47*288 = 13,536 carrier triangles. If ShellPlan::new succeeds, it retains those outer indices and adds an inner copy, so this disc alone has at least 27,072 planned final triangles before other spaulder shells or edge walls.
findings.why_it_matters: The owning guide and sampling.rs specify a general 10,000-triangle per-model runtime target including hidden construction, while separating dense bake sources. The selected public limb build and creator fitted-limb sources pass this design into the same chart path, but the inspected scope does not establish which assets ship at runtime or whether a later stage reduces, rejects, or substitutes geometry.
findings.conditions: Conditional on enabling an optional besagew and its default radial fluting, valid remaining design and successful kernel/chart/shell/fit construction. Actual UI interaction, shader/device success, produced/exported mesh, final readback length, visual output, runtime asset selection and downstream simplification were not observed. The guide says generally below the target, so this is a bounded discrepancy requiring scope/policy reconciliation rather than an asserted universally enforced limit.
findings.historical_relation: 774 CONTRACT-595 and ADDITIONAL-067/068 and published ASSESSMENT-LIMB-METAL-95E describe the selected 48–576 raw radial columns and 96-column minimum; their original scopes and the earlier reader remain unchanged. No existing besagew-specific triangle claim was located in the selected 059 queue, but absence of an exact search term is not proof of global uniqueness. Central should check aliases before assigning a count.
findings.future_direction: Decide whether this chart is bake-only or a runtime artifact and establish an owned detail/budget path that preserves silhouette and fluting intent. Actual mesh counts and model-quality acceptance belong to later authorized product validation.

findings.classification: Low-impact exact existing-owner reuse suggestion, not an observed numeric error.
findings.claim: BesagewDesign stores a Milliradians outward tilt. In the spaulder source the same value is independently projected using f32::from(raw)/1000 for the chart-axis sine/cosine and for a native design float. The existing Milliradians::radians method implements the same conversion in the owning type, and the shader string consumes the latter as the disc tilt.
findings.qualification: Both projections are explicit native float boundaries, the current arithmetic is identical and the design is immutably borrowed; no actual divergence or behavioral failure is shown. Reusing the existing exact conversion is a maintenance suggestion rather than a duplicate source-of-truth defect. No range should be narrowed merely to do so.
findings.future_direction: Consider the existing radians adapter for both native projections and preserve current values, axis and sign. Central decides whether this bounded owner-fit suggestion belongs in the ledger.

findings.classification: Conditional unvalidated-input question; no observed failure or additional unique defect asserted.
findings.claim: The editor forms end - 2*fade, start + 2*fade, and end - start directly from public u16 authoring fields before drawing dependent ranges. Arbitrary raw invalid field combinations can violate arithmetic preconditions, but the normal saved-design parser validates every design before returning, and the inspected valid radial validator bounds start to 200–700, end to 800–1000, fade to 50–250 and requires end-start >= 2*fade.
findings.qualification: Do not claim the inspected saved-design loader delivers invalid data: it calls ParametricDesign::validate and then the limb/besagew/radial gates. The editor also selects checked default values and uses bounded controls. Whether another in-memory producer can pass unvalidated state or later mutations break these relations is not established; no editor or input was executed.
findings.future_direction: Trace alternate state producers before judging whether the editor needs its own explicit error/admission boundary; preserve valid slider transitions rather than inventing an invalid-input policy.

lenses.assessment: Shader program text is a native source boundary, not by itself a semantic magic-string issue; q2691 remains a distinct historical context.

Twelve samples per spoke and 96 minimum columns are named algorithm choices; the source-derived triangle budget consequence requires ownership and intended runtime/bake scope, not indiscriminate constant renaming.
Besagew owns radial controls and Milliradians owns angle conversion; two direct numeric projections have an exact existing conversion suggestion.
Native tilt projections exactly match Milliradians::radians; same units and sign confirmed from source, with no current numeric divergence established.
Radial and linear PlateFluting share count/width/depth leaves but have different valid count and position domains; do not collapse their field identities without a domain decision.
Radial validation orders bounds before end-start and fade*2; selected admitted ranges prevent u16 underflow/overflow. Editor operations on unvalidated raw state require separate caller evidence.
Radial interval and fades are checked as a relation. Chart rows, columns and final triangle count form another cross-layer relationship whose runtime budget and asset destination remain open.
LimbShape::shape checks design before spaulder dispatch; the selected saved-design parser also validates. Freely constructible raw design and other helper call sites are not proven safe.
Option<RadialFluting> intentionally represents no spokes; zero defaults in the native float port are sentinel encodings, not proof a separate payload/enum defect.

Current two tilt projections use the same immutable source and mathematically identical conversion; no divergent retained facts established. Budget target and generated topology are separate contract evidence, not duplicate stored authority.
Assigned old/current individual bytes match; this does not prove whole snapshot, visual generation, runtime output or all dependent code unchanged.
Selected editor -> optional radial design, validated limb -> spaulder -> cyclic apex chart -> shell plan edges are visible in separately scoped source; actual runtime asset producer remains untraced.
Serde and value-type derives exist, while validation enforces nontrivial interval relations. No safe removal of custom validation or other boilerplate is established.
